site_name: 21-22 Carmelita House The MallEalingW5 2PJ
description: Refurbishment of Carmelita House. Ground floor to remain as clinical space (Children's Services) change of the first floor from all office space to a mix of office and clinical space for Child and Adolescent Mental Health Services (CAMHS). The second, third and fourth floors will remain as office space to be used by NHS staff, Use (Class E).As part of the proposed works the ventilation, heating and cooling system for the building is being upgraded requiring the addition of external louvres to several elevations and the placement of external plant onto the roof of the rear extension (Second Floor level).
